:::{#exr-closed-half-space-practice}
#### Testing whether a point is in a closed half-space

A [closed half-space](#def-closed-half-space) adds the [hyperplane](linear-algebra-matrices.qmd#def-hyperplane) itself
to an [open half-space](#def-half-space).
Let $\mathcal{H}$ be the line in $\reals^2$ with $\vec{w} = (2, -1)$ and $b = -3$.

Decide whether the point $(2, 1)$ is in the closed half-space $\mathcal{H}^+ \cup \mathcal{H}$.

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

Evaluate $\dprod{\vec{w}}{\vx} + b$ at $(2, 1)$.

:::
